name: practical-auth-book
description: 認証・認可システムの設計と実装を体系的に学ぶ実践的な技術書
author: ITDO Inc.（株式会社アイティードゥ）

scripts.preview: npm run build && npx http-server docs -p 8080 --silent
scripts.test:light: npm run lint:light && npm run build
scripts.build:validate: npm run check:metadata && npm run check-links
scripts.help:
echo 'Available commands:
  npm run setup - Interactive setup
  npm run build - Build the book
  npm run build:safe - Build with conflict detection
  npm run check:metadata - Validate metadata and navigation consistency
  npm run check:security - Run npm audit without optional dependencies
  npm test - Run metadata, conflicts, and link checker fixtures
  npm run build:validate - Validate canonical published metadata and links without regenerating docs
  npm run check-conflicts - Check Jekyll conflicts
  npm run fix-conflicts - Auto-fix Jekyll conflicts
  npm run check-links - Validate published internal links, images, and anchors
  npm run setup:hooks - Install pre-commit hooks
  npm run validate:config - Validate configuration files
  npm run preview - Local preview
  npm run configure:workflows - Disable problematic workflows
  npm run deploy - Deploy to GitHub Pages'
scripts.test: npm run check:metadata && npm run check:figure-index && npm run check-conflicts && npm run test:links && npm run test:figure-index
